description.value:
Armstech engineers are the artisans of the armory, forever taking apart blasters and vibroweapons to see how the next model could hit harder, faster, or truer. Where others see a finished weapon, they see a prototype waiting for the right modification.

Their signature creation always rides at their hip: a single weapon rebuilt again and again until it channels their own expertise. In combat they trust that weapon to close gaps, punch through defenses, and eventually turn a whole battlefield's worth of tech powers into a single well-aimed shot.
